easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
